files.main.yaml:
name: safe-state
nodes:
  first:
    type: compute
    os: linux
    services:
    - name: api
      port: 443
    - port: 80
  second:
    type: compute
    os: linux
propositions:
  safe:
    description: The admitted safe-state condition holds.
    subjects:
    - nodes.first
    - nodes.second
    - nodes.first.services.api
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: safe
      semantic_ref: urn:example:safe
      expected: true
    evidence_requirements:
    - readback
assertions:
  safe:
    proposition: safe
    role: postcondition
evidence_requirements:
  readback:
    source_refs:
    - nodes.first
    - nodes.second
    - nodes.first.services.api
    scope_refs:
    - nodes.first
    - nodes.second
    - nodes.first.services.api
    window: safe-state-verification
    channel: api_response
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: none
    integrity: checksum
    retention: run_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
safe_state:
  default:
    kind: safe-hold
    assertion_refs:
    - safe
